_about: proto-kitchen (Zafar's rapid prototype, 1 Nov): the corn stall's own data (js/cook/stations/corn.js; the order is recipes.corn in data/cook.json). A sekelo redress on one screen, top-down: the raw cobs (left) and the cooked plate (right) either side of the grill, the chutneys and dressings on a tray below, each with its word card. `mechanic.levels`: sideMs how long one side takes on the grill; slots how many cobs the grill holds; `palette` the art colours (data, not code).

station.name: Corn stall
station.verb: Grill, turn once, then what goes on
station.goal: Tap the box: a cob goes on the grill. When it glows, tap it to turn it; when it glows again, tap it: onto the plate. Then tap what they asked for: it goes on. Tap the plate to give it to them.

phases.grill: Tap the box for a cob. Turn it once when it glows; take it off when it glows again.
phases.dress: Tap what they asked for: it goes on the corn.

kitchen.about: Sprint 18 prep (7 Nov): see data/stations/eggs.json kitchen.about (the same shape in every kitchen game). The station's own station/words/mechanic keys are untouched.

recipe.ref: data/cook.json recipes.corn (its slots and say-lines live there until wave 2 moves them here)
recipe._levels: As recipes.corn.slots today. sideMs (a side on the grill) and slots (cobs the grill holds) by level are mechanic.levels (the station reads them now). 'no' is the chance of a 'not X' ask.

scene.view: T at the stall's table (a sekelo redress on one screen)
scene._bg: CT centre-cropped to 16:9; honey oak planks (the art plan's table), a leaf shadow top-left.

tray.note: the dressing board stays a plain drawn board (art plan Q7); 1300 x 200 at y 590

host.note: Nani's guide box stands in for Hannah Mami until her approved sheet exists (Zafar, 1 Nov)

crate._note: CX is a kept best try: six cobs in a wooden crate, tips right, but green husk leaves on them (the alternative chat has six clean cobs, tips left). Tap: a cob goes on the grill.

cob._note: raw, one side grilled (half), the turn (the ungrilled side up, so it reads raw: the second glow), done; one canvas. The station has three looks today: raw, half, done.

dressings._note: steel katoris, one canvas each; the six ids are the station's DRESS

onCob._note: CO (the dressings drawn on a cob) failed and stays in the redo list: the game keeps its drawn drops for each dressing until it is redone
